title: Surface Growth Driven by an Optimality Criterion
summary: We propose a variational framework for accretive surface growth driven by an optimality principle. Rather than prescribing a kinetic law, the configuration at each time step is obtained, within a time-discrete setting, as the solution of a constrained minimization problem. Growth is modeled as an irreversible surface deposition process subject to a global mass constraint, while the driving mechanism is encoded in an objective functional, here taken to be the structural mean compliance.
